title: Security Deposit Schedule by Commercial Credit Grade - C&I
content:
For Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts, the security deposit figures are expressed by the customer's commercial credit grade and are identical on all six Beacon Ridge C&I structures.

## Months of estimated supply cost by grade

| Commercial credit grade | Months of estimated supply cost |
|---|---|
| A | 0 |
| B | 1 |
| C | 2 |
| Not rated | 2 |

## Other deposit terms (every structure)

| Term | Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index, Block and Index, both Fixed Energy structures, Fixed All-In and Fixed All-In Renewable |
|---|---|
| Reference price used to estimate monthly supply cost | 9.75 cents per kWh |
| Ceiling on combined deposits held across all of a customer's C&I contracts | $250000.00 |
| Required deposit posted before the enrollment is submitted to the utility | yes |
| When a held deposit is refunded | once the contract is closed and its final bill has posted |
| Annual interest paid on held deposits | 0.00% |

## Points of reading

- Grades C and not rated carry the same number of months (2).
- The $250000.00 ceiling is measured across all of the customer's C&I contracts together, not per contract.
- Held deposits earn no interest (0.00% a year).
